column3: The manager talked to the local press about the new store opening. (經理向當地媒體談論了新店開幕的事宜。)
We need to send an email to potential clients today. (我們今天需要發送電子郵件給潛在客戶。)
Many companies compete for the top spot in this market. (許多公司都在爭奪該市場的第一名寶座。)
Please join the morning briefing in the main conference room. (請參加在主會議室舉行的晨間簡報會。)
The security officer checked everyone's ID badge at the entrance. (警衛在入口處檢查了每個人的識別證。)
The jury found the driver guilty of breaking the speed limit. (陪審團認定該駕駛違反速限有罪。)
Please pass through airport security before heading to your gate. (前往登機門之前，請先通過機場安檢。)
You can sign up for a thirty-day free trial on our website. (你可以在我們的網站上註冊三十天的免費試用。)
The judge listened carefully to both sides of the story. (法官仔細聆聽了雙方的說法。)
The bank will issue a new credit card to you next week. (銀行下週會發行一張新的信用卡給你。)
Road construction caused heavy traffic delays on my way to work. (道路施工在我上班途中造成了嚴重的交通延誤。)
Our office is temporarily closed for repairs until Friday morning. (我們的辦公室暫時關閉維修，直到週五早上。)
Do not accuse him of taking the files without clear proof. (在沒有明確證據的情況下，不要指控他拿走了文件。)
She visited the American embassy to apply for a travel visa. (她前往美國大使館申請旅行簽證。)
The company spokesman was quick to deny the rumor of layoffs. (公司發言人迅速否認了解僱的傳聞。)
Good sleep is the best defence against getting sick during winter. (充足的睡眠是冬天預防生病的最好防禦手段。)
Dark clouds threaten heavy rain, so remember to bring an umbrella. (烏雲預示著可能下大雨，所以記得帶把傘。)
The hotel has a strict ban on smoking inside guest rooms. (這家飯店嚴格禁止客房內吸菸。)
She works as an accountant at an international consulting firm. (她在一家國際顧問公司擔任會計師。)
My brother plans to travel overseas for his summer vacation. (我哥哥計畫暑假去海外旅行。)
